fusions.name: Fetter Lash
fusions.desc: A lashing weapon strike that deals 12 damage, makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and slows it by 20% for 3 seconds. Your afflictions on the target then spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Reeled Short
fusions.desc: Snaps a weighted line taut on a target up to 6 tiles away, dealing 20 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and slowing it by 30% for 3 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Hauled Hand Over Hand
fusions.desc: Hauls on the links, pulling up to 3 enemies within 6 tiles onto you and holding their attention for 7 seconds.

fusions.name: Link Added
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, you gain a shield worth 12% of your maximum health for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
